status: PROVISIONAL casting for the locked shooting script. Nothing here is approved by Daxtyn. No final dialogue has been recorded. The 18 handoff roles keep their ../voices.json voices, except the ADULT VILLAGER (recast, see his entry); the 8 new roles are cast here and have not been auditioned.
rules: Role keys are the speaker names exactly as in dialogue.json.
One voice per role for the whole episode. Never change a role's voice between scenes, and never let two roles share a voice.
The text sent to TTS is final/dialogue.json 'text' with the 'pronunciation' respellings applied (and a leading or trailing em dash removed). Subtitles always use the unmodified 'text'.
[ORIGINAL] lines L011, L046, L047 are spoken word for word.

Lines in the wording Daxtyn approved on 2026-10-18 (L048, L053, L054, L109, X17-11) are spoken word for word in that wording; the old wording is never recorded (see special_lines). L048 replaces his [ORIGINAL] line.
Never speak bracketed notes, delivery notes, speaker names or the [ORIGINAL] marker.
Dragons never speak. Their sounds are in creature_vocals.
A human recording, when one exists for a line, always replaces the TTS take (see human_recordings).
An approved take is a file. Keep it. Do not regenerate approved lines (Piper differs on every run; Kokoro repeats exactly only with the same model, text, voice and speed).
Blended voices (primary.blend) are new: audition each against every role in its scenes before approving a take.
Only Kokoro English voices with Apache-2.0 weights are used, and not the ones ../voices.json avoids (named after a commercial product's voice, or am_santa).

kokoro.role: PRIMARY for all roles (better quality than Piper in these tests; license-clean)
kokoro.model: Kokoro-82M v1.0, ONNX int8 export (kokoro-v1.0.int8.onnx, 92 MB) + voices-v1.0.bin (28 MB)
kokoro.runtime: pip: kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 (MIT), onnxruntime 1.30 (MIT); system espeak-ng 1.51 (GPL-3.0, used as a tool for phonemes)
kokoro.license: Model weights Apache-2.0 (commercial use allowed). kokoro-onnx MIT.
kokoro.caution: Kokoro's model card (hosted on Hugging Face, blocked here, so not re-checked from this machine) describes its training audio as public-domain and permissively licensed recordings plus synthetic audio from closed commercial TTS models. To stay clear of imitating a commercial product's voice, this casting does not use the voices named after one (af_alloy, af_nova, am_echo, am_onyx, bm_fable) or am_santa.
kokoro.controls: voice, speed (0.5-2.0), lang (en-us / en-gb). No pitch control: pitch_semitones is applied afterwards with SoX ('pitch <cents>'). Voices can also be blended (weighted average of the 510x256 style arrays) if more distinct voices are needed.

piper_libritts.role: FALLBACK (faster, lower quality; 904 speakers in one model)
piper_libritts.model: Piper voice en-us-libritts-high (rhasspy/piper v0.0.2 release, 121 MB)
piper_libritts.runtime: pip: piper-tts 1.8.0 (GPL-3.0-or-later; the license applies to the program, not to audio you make with it)
piper_libritts.license: Dataset LibriTTS (OpenSLR 60), CC BY 4.0: commercial use allowed WITH attribution. Trained from scratch (not fine-tuned from a restricted voice).
piper_libritts.attribution_text: Some voices synthesized with Piper (rhasspy) using a model trained on LibriTTS (Zen et al., CC BY 4.0).

not_recommended.reason: Dataset RyanSpeech is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: NON-COMMERCIAL only (and share-alike).
Dataset is the Blizzard 2013 Lessac corpus under its own CSTR licence (the licence page was blocked here). That corpus is distributed for research use - treat as NON-COMMERCIAL.
Dataset is CC0, but the model card says it was fine-tuned from the Ryan voice (CC BY-NC-SA data): treat as NON-COMMERCIAL.
Dataset OpenSLR 83 is CC BY-SA 4.0, but fine-tuned from Ryan (CC BY-NC-SA): treat as NON-COMMERCIAL. Also 16 kHz.
Model card says 'License: see URL' (MycroftAI mimic3-voices) and no per-voice licence file was found; fine-tuned from Ryan. Unclear - avoid.
Source voice (Mycroft mimic3 'apope') LICENSE reads 'Copyright 2022 Mycroft AI, All Rights Reserved'. Do not use.

render_defaults.working_format: mono WAV per line, 48000 Hz, 24-bit PCM
render_defaults.resample: ffmpeg -af aresample=48000:resampler=soxr  (or: sox in.wav -b 24 out.wav rate -v 48k)
render_defaults.pitch_shift: sox in.wav out.wav pitch <semitones*100>   (apply each role's primary.pitch_semitones; roles with a non-zero shift: CHILD +4, WATCHMAN +2, QUEEN FALL -2, GUARD -2)
render_defaults.how_to_split: Synthesize each sentence of a line separately and join with sentence_gap_s of silence; this gives control over pauses that TTS does not.
render_defaults.trim: Trim leading/trailing silence to 40 ms, then add a 5 ms fade at both ends.
render_defaults.line_level: Normalize every line to the same speech level (-20 dBFS RMS over the voiced part, peak below -3 dBFS). Performance level (quiet, whisper, shout) is set in the mix, not in the file.

L011.speaker: ALEXANDRIA
L011.how: Synthesize with the role's own voice at speed 0.8, then whisper DSP: replace the voiced source with noise shaped by the speech's smoothed spectral envelope (cepstral lifter ~1.5 ms), keep ~10% of the voiced signal for intelligibility, high-pass 250 Hz. Mix 10-12 dB below normal dialogue, close and dry (no room reverb).
L011.honesty: TTS cannot really whisper. This DSP imitation keeps the voice's identity but will sound processed. Strongly recommended: record this line with a real person.
L011.note: [ORIGINAL] - exact words 'My pretty little weapon', no extra word, no punctuation added. Spoken for the hatchling, not the room.

non_verbal_human.rider_scream_1F: C14: the burned scout rider screams, a raw, wordless sound loud enough to carry over the wind. Keep the voice unidentifiable (no gender or age cue that could point at an identity; CANON LOCK 11): a processed human scream layered with wind, not a TTS line.
non_verbal_human.scout_cry_1F: C15/C16: the scout dragon's scream as the wing tears (creature_vocals.SCOUT).
non_verbal_human.abby_cry_X12: X12: Abby's short, sharp cry as the arm is set, cut off by her own breath. Human recording strongly recommended; TTS cannot do it.
non_verbal_human.crowd_3C: 3C/X25/X26: crowd screams and calls, built from many short human takes (a volunteer group recording, or CC0 crowd libraries recorded in the manifest), never one looped scream.
non_verbal_human.breaths: Breaths and efforts (the climb in X3, the gate in X14, the beam in X28) are recorded or taken from CC0 libraries, not synthesized.

creature_vocals.rule: No dragon speaks. Dragons communicate by posture, breath, growls, calls and eye movement (screenplay). These are sound-design settings, not TTS.
creature_vocals.method: Procedural synthesis in Python (numpy/scipy) - prototypes exist - optionally layered with Daxtyn's own recorded growls/breaths pitched down. No downloaded animal recordings unless each file is checked CC0.

SCOUT.prototype: scout_pass_sharp_crack.wav (enters RIGHT, exits LEFT, matching the shot list's pass direction)
SCOUT.pass_geometry: shotlist.json conventions.the_pass_1E: the scout comes head-on from ahead and passes through the gap between Leaf and Charcoal, on Leaf's LEFT (seaward) side = the FAR side from the inland camera, never between Leaf and the camera. Pan R -> L, slightly behind Leaf in the image (a little less direct than a camera-side pass); the wake then surrounds the listener. In the 1E-04 front shot the wake comes from screen RIGHT (Abby's left).

human_recordings.why: These four carry the emotion (pain, fear, whisper, command, warmth). TTS is fine for temporary animatic audio and acceptable for minor roles.
human_recordings.choice_file: episodes/s01e01/audio/vo/takes.json  {"L072": "human/abby/L072_take2.wav", ...}; a line not listed uses the TTS take
human_recordings.format: WAV preferred (48 kHz, 24-bit). Phone recordings (m4a) are fine - they get converted with ffmpeg.
human_recordings.consent: Get each person's OK to use their voice in the published episode; a parent's OK for anyone under 18. Credit them by name only if they want, in the end titles (the screenplay says credit only real contributors).

voice_pool.note: All nine allowed male voices were already cast; any further male role needs another blend or a human recording.
